The '''Incom Corporation Research, Development and Engineering Center''' was a scientific organization working for the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]].

==History==
It worked on Incom Corporation designs, including the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].
